{{Quote|Under any other circumstance I'd order a tactical withdrawal. But if we fall back, we might as well give up.|Ilic Nadab|<ref name="Savage Attack" />}}
'''Ilic Nadab''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Mirialan/Legends|Mirialan]] [[General/Legends|general]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] during the [[Galactic War]]. In [[3642 BBY]] he was dispatched to the [[Aurek Base]] on [[Hoth/Legends|Hoth]] after his predecessor managed to lose a strategically important region of [[Clabburn Tundra]]. Nadab viewed the plateau as vital to Republic effort on Hoth and so dispatched a competent Republic citizen to combat the threat to Republic and [[Talz/Legends|Talz]] forces stationed there.<ref name="Savage Attack" />

==Behind the scenes==
Ilic Nadab is a non-player character from the massively multi-player online role playing game ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' released by [[BioWare]] in [[2011]]. He is voiced by [[Fred Tatasciore]].<ref name="Savage Attack" />
